protocol.checkpoint: fixed final step, no test-based selection
protocol.teacher: Lambertian direct area-light samples with analytic visibility rays; two fixed world-space light rigs; fog composed after lighting
protocol.inputs: RGB compressed, world normals reconstructed from observed depth, observed camera Z / 30, known valid mask
protocol.input_noise: 0.05 percent relative depth in training; clean and 0.2 percent in held-out evaluation
protocol.target_limitations: Only spheres and ground, diffuse materials, fixed rigs, four light samples; no indirect lighting, specular materials, game images or generative prior

temporal_scope: 48 perspective camera-rotation/translation pairs; nearest reprojection, matching primitive/depth, subpixel distance <0.35; error vs own target, no history or moving objects
next_gate: Generalization beyond synthetic spheres, temporal behavior, complete D3D12 GPU timing/memory and available game inputs.
